quickTry.label: 15-Second Try
quickTry.summary: Runs an ephemeral in-memory SQLite store over the bundled sample project. Writes nothing into your directory and requires no Java, Docker, or Ollama.
quickTry.note: Scale losslessly to the full ArcadeDB engine at any time with cairnmind migrate --to server.

platforms.label: Linux & WSL2
platforms.summary: Full local stack with Java 21 (or Docker), pinned ArcadeDB 26.11.1, tmux 3.4+ terminal workspace, and optional local Ollama models.
prereqCommands: sudo apt install -y openjdk-21-jre-headless tmux git curl
platforms.installLabel: 2. Run installer from source or release archive

platforms.label: macOS
platforms.summary: Tested on Apple silicon with Homebrew Java 21, tmux, uv, and Ollama. Uses the same POSIX installer script.
platforms.prereqLabel: 1. Install via Homebrew and link Java 21
prereqCommands: brew install openjdk@21 tmux uv ollama
platforms.installLabel: 2. Run the installer from the unpacked release or clone

platforms.label: Native Windows
platforms.summary: Runs natively without WSL2 or tmux. Launches the standalone Textual workspace backed by an owner-only Windows Named Pipe for person-confirmed actions.
platforms.prereqLabel: 1. Install Git, uv, and Java 21 (or Docker Desktop)

platforms.label: Docker Engine
platforms.summary: Runs Cairnmind's digest-pinned ArcadeDB container (ghcr.io/piotrwozn/cairnmind-arcadedb) on 127.0.0.1:2480 with your local data directory mounted.
platforms.prereqLabel: Switch engine mode to Docker (or connect to a remote database)
platforms.installLabel: Verify storage, pulse, and MCP presets

firstProjectFlow: cairnmind remember my-app "Accounts lock after five failed logins."
cairnmind ask my-app "When do accounts lock?"
